source_clause: CW2.) The second Comfort widget screen includes all Comfort features available to the vehicle (i.e. Heated/Vented seats, Heated steering wheel). On the 50% widget, these features are separated between driver and passenger. If the vehicle is not equipped with Comfort Features this widget page will not be shown.
reasoning: 驗證目標：17.3（CW2）定出 Comfort widget 之第二畫面含本車所有可用之 Comfort 功能，並定其於無 Comfort 功能之車輛不顯示，三個 037 leaf 對應之，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）；本輪產 `-01`／`-03` 兩條。關鍵情境條件：本節之配置條件為 profile §3.2 **第十六軸「Comfort Features 有無」**（50 §1 登記，**功能型**）—— 其二值皆為本節之逐字原文，`-01` 取正向值、`-03` 取否定值，出處皆標 17.3；依 **R-C34**，第九軸與第十三軸暴露 → 全數補，EMEA 排除補（ch16 十八節無 widget 條文），第十二軸不補；**第十六軸為功能型故不進 `interface_axis_review` 之鍵**（判定依據見 profile §3.2 之附註）。為什麼這樣切：`-01`（有功能時列出）與 `-03`（無功能時整頁不顯示）為同一條件之兩側，依 §7 各自成條使正負兩向皆被驗，且兩者之失效可獨立發生（頁顯示了但內容不全／頁根本不該顯示卻顯示）。刻意略過：`-01` 之 ER 以條文自舉之二例（Heated/Vented seats、Heated steering wheel）為觀察對象，該二者為 `i.e.` 之明文列舉非造值；**`-02`（50% widget 之駕駛／乘客分列）仍停下** —— widget 尺寸不在既有軸內，與 `125-08`／`127-01`／`127-02` 同因（DR #6）。

tcs.tc_title: Second widget screen lists the available Comfort features
tcs.test_item:
CW2.) The second Comfort widget screen includes all Comfort features available to the vehicle (i.e. Heated/Vented seats, Heated steering wheel).

(The Comfort widget is shown on the home screen; The vehicle is equipped with Comfort features, such as heated/vented seats and a heated steering wheel; move to the second Comfort widget screen)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [test-setup] The Comfort widget is shown on the home screen
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle is equipped with Comfort features, such as heated/vented seats and a heated steering wheel (17.3)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
5. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the home screen
2. Move to the second Comfort widget screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Comfort widget shows the Climate screen
2. The second widget screen shows the Comfort features available to the vehicle
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
